query:
SELECT 
  cq.searchId, cq.companyName, cq.status, cq.errorMessage,
  c.enrichmentStatus, c.fitScore, c.urgencyScore,
  CASE WHEN c.briefData IS NULL OR c.briefData = '' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END as has_brief,
  CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NULL OR c.salesApproachData = '' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END as has_sales
FROM campaign_queue cq
JOIN companies c ON c.id = cq.companyId
WHERE cq.status = 'failed' AND cq.searchId IN (1500002, 1500003)
LIMIT 20;
